verdict.rationale: Resend ships official SDKs referenced throughout docs (e.g., 'any official SDK' in resend-docs-16, 'CLI, and MCP server' alongside SDKs in resend-docs-18) and independent hands-on feedback praises the breadth and idiomatic quality of its SDK support across many languages including Elixir (resend-comm-5). This confirms an AI-native/developer user can build against official, well-regarded SDKs rather than raw HTTP calls only. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party page enumerating all supported SDK languages/repos in the evidence pack itself.
